description: Check that every write step in a multi-step plan has an undo step, and give the rollback order — For an agent plan made of steps with declared effects (read or write), checks every write in the plan, run or not, has a compensation step that exists, is itself a write, is not its own compensation, and that the dependencies have no cycle; flags writes declared irreversible; and, given which steps have completed, returns the compensations to run in reverse completion order. Does not judge whether

completed.description: Step ids completed so far, in completion order. Only used for rollbackOrder and to say an irreversible write has already run; coverage is always checked for the whole plan.

compensation.description: Id of the step that undoes this one.

irreversible.description: Declared impossible to undo (send email, wire transfer).

name: compensation-coverage
